name: Theme
description: Theme singleton managing dark/light color mode. Defines darkTheme (Noir dark: #161C24 bg) and lightTheme (inverse: #f8f8f8 bg) palettes with 7 CSS custom properties (--bg, --surface, --panel, --primary, --secondary, --tertiary, --border). Exports singletons darkTheme/lightTheme constants and a Theme class instance with setDark(), toggle(), and apply() methods that write to document.documentElement.style.

methods.name: setDark
methods.description: Set mode and apply CSS properties

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Flip isDark and apply CSS properties
